top_signal.title: Need help - $6k inventory lost in move.
top_signal.summary: Hi, I just moved apartments where I keep a lot of business inventory and during the move $6k of inventory was "lost in transit" or stolen. Business insurance isn't covered because it's a move and off the insured premise, and also they need a police report. I spoke to the police and they said I need to take it up with the moving company since I hired them, so they won't file a report. The moving company said they only compensate by 60 cents per pound, which equals $6.00 total pay out. This is my inventory that I need to sell for my business, so I'm just really sad right now and don't know what to do. Police said I could take them to small claims court, but that sounds tedious and I'm looking for any other solutions first. I haven't responded to the moving company yet to accept the $6 payout, because I'm wondering if I can go back and reason with them, because don't they have their own insurance they can claim for instances like this? SIGH :( Any advice or direction would be so appreciated.       submitted by     /u/abh032000       [link]       [comments]
